deadline.value: For full consideration of fall admission, submit all materials by December 7, 2026; the Graduate School deadline is April 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: please have all of your materials submitted by December 7 of the previous year

also.quote: Application Review begins December 1 and ends on April 1 each year

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires or accepts GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry no longer requires or even accepts GRE scores as part of the application

gre_subject.value: The GRE Chemistry subject test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require the GRE Chemistry exam

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need an advisor before applying; all students are admitted independent of any research advisor.
supervisor.quote: All students are admitted independent of any potential research advisor

funding.value: Students admitted in full standing receive a stipend and tuition waiver, renewable for up to five years.
funding.quote: Students admitted in full standing receive full financial support, which includes a stipend and tuition waiver

also.quote: This support is renewable on an annual basis for up to five years

entry_route.value: The Ph.D. is designed for students with a bachelor's degree in chemistry or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: This program is designed for students with a bachelor’s degree in chemistry or a closely related field

notes: The department says it has no minimum TOEFL or IELTS and defers to the International Office and Graduate School.
